assets.title: Wikipedia 2001 HomePage（Wayback 渲染截图）
assets.evidence: Rendered locally from the Wayback capture. The page itself displays its date and says Wikipedia started in January 2001 and had over 6,000 articles. The screenshot timestamp is the archive capture time, not the page edit time.
assets.rights: The archived page states GFDL for its text; image/logo and any third-party rights should be checked separately.
